NOTES: The v0.2.0 treatment successfully addresses the previous failures; the 1.35x zoom and 0.45 dim strength provide a clear, product-quality visual hierarchy that draws the eye to the action without losing broadcast context. The player-priority tracker is now robust, correctly identifying and centering on the players at t=8 (avoiding the background ad-board) and maintaining focus across all other timestamps. Players remain fully readable with limbs intact, and the 28-pixel edge feather ensures a professional, non-distracting transition into the dimmed periphery while preserving the full spatial context of the match.
